subtitles.pp.item.pattern_print.denied: Block is copyrighted, cannot be printed
subtitles.pp.item.pattern_print.fail: Pattern Print has no blocks to use
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.1: 1. Hold item to see selection range
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.10: 10. Put item into crafting grid at any time to reset saved pattern and block type
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.2: 2. Shift-right click a block to save it
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.3: 3. If any other blocks of the same type are present within the selection, their relative position will also be saved
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.4: 4. Once a pattern is saved, shift-rightclicking a different block will change block type but not pattern
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.5: 5. Holding the item now shows how the pattern will be placed
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.6: 6. Right click in air (or press %s) to rotate pattern clockwise in Y axis
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.7: 7. Right click in air (or press %s) while crouching to rotate pattern clockwise in viewed horizontal axis
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.8: 8. Right click on a block to place the pattern
tooltip.pp.pattern_print.9: 9. Blocks will only be placed if they can be consumed from inventory and placement is not obstructed
